column3: Kuroneko Route · The Discussion with Dad
I strengthened my resolve to face Kuroneko once more.
Because I've received encouragement from many people.
I'll work hard in my own way even if I'm rejected by her again. I've made such a resolve to myself.
Yo. It looks like you haven't made much progress.
What do you want? You sure have a lot of free time if you can come to the freshmen's classroom during summer.
It's not because I have spare time. I'm here because I have something to do.
Is it something that specifically requires you to be here?
It does.
You're... unexpectedly stubborn.
Stubborn? Whatever are you talking about?
I'm sure you know about it? If you're being so reckless... I'm sure you're about to reach your limit?
Heh, not at all...  I am merely doing what is necessary to accomplish what I want.
How stubborn.
Hehe, this is something that anyone would be able to do if they wanted to.
Doing your best to reach your goal, how is that wrong?
People don't just work themselves to exhaustion!
Look at you, you're visibly swaying...
Hey, let me help...
Not needed.
...Tch, at least let me finish what I have to say.
My reply will be the same no matter how many times you say it. Why don't you put in some effort to learn that?
...You're not looking at me from the start.
It's useless no matter what you say, I have no intention of listening to you.
So anything I say is useless?
Yes, that's right. So leave me be.
Please don't stop me any more, it's just a little more so...
Isn't it a given that I have to stop you?
Do you think I'll allow you to continue being reckless when you are in your current state?
That's why I've said, you're a hindrance.
If being worried about you is being a hindrance, then I'll continue to be a hindrance as many times as I want.
I'll accept your kind intentions since you've put it this way. I appreciate it. That's why...
...Do you understand that everything will be over once you collapse at that moment just for "a little more"?
Of course. However, this time it's just... my ability is still not sufficient.
It's a pity to be unable to finish something. I have some regret... But it is my desire to walk this path of sacrifice.
...What kind of desire is that?
...As expected, it looks like our opinions differ.
Isn't it about time you let me go? This amount of time is very important to me right now.
But you haven't listened to anything I've said?
It's pointless no matter what you say. Don't you understand? Both of us have no intention of giving way.
Of course, I'm here just to stop you.
Really? However, I won't give in, no matter what you say.
So please stop wasting time. The time I allocated to you is hereby over.
...What's the meaning of that?
It means exactly what I just said. At the very least, we shouldn't meet until... after the manuscript is done.
You'll only cause me trouble when you look for me.
You mean... you won't even come to school?
Yes. Work can be done at home.
Are you an idiot!?
To go that far to avoid me... and I can't even care about you, is that what you're saying?
...It's as you have said. Having that intention is enough.
So, please don't interfere unnecessarily.
...What if I were to say no? If I say I'm not going to allow this and even forcefully stopping you?
That's just repeating what we've said today. It's unproductive. It's useless, give it up.
I'll keep stopping you until you do.
I won't stop. ...No, I'll give it my all to compensate for lost time.
Tch... That's unfair... How am I supposed to respond to what you've said...?
You don't have to. I've said this before, haven't I?
There's only one thing I want you to do right now.
...And that would be?
...You ignoring me.
That again...
How about it? If you're really worried about me, can you do me this small favor?
What do you mean by ignoring you?
It's simple. Don't talk to me even if we meet, it'll be just like we don't know each other. Treating me as a complete stranger will do.
Just like a complete stranger, how is that even possible...
I'm too worried about you, why is it that you can't understand?
...Senpai, just give up on me now...
What, hey!
Is that... your true wish?
Yes, that's right.
You're totally.... okay with that?
Obviously. I myself am wishing for it.
...Damn... Is there no way I can stop you?
...Obviously. I would not be stopped by you. Well, that's that...
So, it shall end here. I'll say it one last time.
Leave me alone.
...Until when?
Let's see... until after the manuscript is done.
At least, we'll have to meet after school starts, right?
So, before the manuscript is completed, we are complete strangers. Don't talk to me even if we meet, all right?
I'm sure you can bear with it if it's this kind of level, right?
....Are you serious?
Yes, of course.
Even if it's just like you said....when that ends, we can return to our old relationship? Are you going to... go back to before?
The relations of people are something that continuously change, right?
That is why I shall now bid farewell to you.
Damn... Isn't there anything I can say...
To see her walk off, unable to do anything, it's frustrating... Do I just stand here gritting my teeth...
Ah! Hey! Kuroneko, Kuroneko!?
Damn it! T-To the infirmary!
